text: I'm a foster carer, I have a 3 year old girl placed with me who has chickenpox. Spots came out yesterday, she's covered and they're itchy, she keeps scratching so I've cut her nails short and put calamine on. Temp is 37.8 tonight. Apart from the itching she's well in herself. I checked her neck because I know you'll ask and it's fine, she can bend her head right down to look at her tummy without any bother. What I need to know is: does a 37.8 with chickenpox need anything other than what I'm doing, and is there anything I should be giving her for the itch at her age? I also have to log this for her social worker so a clear answer would help. If it's just a case of waiting it out then fine, just tell me that.
